[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 10
- Description: Kirsten follow-up — 5g chocolate mould availability for potential Chinese market order
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  10-minute follow-up with Kirsten Ritschel on availability of a 5-gram chocolate mould in her space, for potential Chinese market procurement.
  
  === THE ASK (verified from the chat screenshot) ===
  WhatsApp thread with **Kirsten Ritschel**, 8:08 AM:
    "Do you happen to have chocolate mold for 5 grams?? Seems this is what the Chinese market is receptive to. We might be getting an order for this from the Chinese market"
  
  Plus four reference images sent in the same thread, which are spec sheets and Chinese e-commerce listings rather than photos of stock:
    - Supplier "Product Information" sheet (bilingual EN/Chinese): Mould Size **275*175mm**; Product Size **34*34*h4mm**; Chocolate Weight **5g**; item number reading variously as 15527352 / 15507052 across OCR passes (digits are low-legibility — NOT asserted as exact).
    - Chinese e-commerce listing screenshot: 巧克力pc模具 (chocolate **PC** mould), catalogue no. **QL-1585**, 克重 5g (5g weight), 成品尺寸 34*34xH4mm (finished size), 外模尺寸 275*175xH24mm (outer mould size).
    - Two further screenshots of the same listing/product imagery at lower legibility.
  
  === WHAT THE SPEC ACTUALLY TELLS US (useful, and it constrains the order) ===
  The mould is **polycarbonate (PC)**, not silicone. That matters commercially:
    - PC is the professional standard for tempering/tabling chocolate — it gives gloss and proper snap, and it tolerates repeated cycling. Silicone does not produce retail-quality gloss.
    - **5g pieces** are tiny. At 34x34x4mm each cavity is a thin tile. 5g x N cavities per 275x175mm sheet — this is a high-cavity-count mould, which means throughput per pour is good but demoulding/consistency is the operational risk.
    - A 5g format is consistent with what the Chinese market tends to favour: small, individually-wrapped, low-unit-price pieces, often sold in multi-flavour gift boxes rather than as a single large bar. That is a genuinely different product shape from a standard ceremonial cacao bar, so it is a **line extension**, not a repack.
    - **Labelling/compliance note**: small-format chocolate moving into China must carry Chinese-language labelling (GB 7718 / GB 28050) and, for chocolate specifically, cocoa-solids declarations per GB/T 19343. Piece size does not exempt it. Any order at this format needs the CN label artwork settled in parallel with the mould, or the first shipment stalls at customs.
  
  === WHY THE HEAVY-METAL THREADS CONNECT ===
  This is not an isolated procurement question. Heavy metals concentrate in cocoa solids, and a **5g piece** in a small-format gift box typically reads as a premium/confections product where cadmium and lead limits are enforced most actively (EU Reg. (EC) 1881/2006 cadmium maximums for cocoa/chocolate categories; US state-level cadmium/lead actions on dark chocolate). The heavy-metal reports being chased from the Cacao Innovation Center on 2026-11-20 for the six September samples are therefore a precondition for this Chinese-market line, not a separate workstream. Selling 5g pieces into a regulated retail channel without those results is not viable.
  
  === TIME BASIS ===
  10 minutes as directed by the governor. TDG derived from the dao_client rubric SSOT (rubric.py: Time (Minutes) = minutes/60*100 = 10/60*100 = **16.67**), not supplied by hand.
  
  === DUPLICATE CHECK ===
  Searched the autopilot service log from 2026-11-01 for "5 gram" / "5g mold" / "mould" / "chocolate mold". **Zero** matching create_dao_submission calls — this follow-up has not been filed before.
  
  === EVIDENCE / ATTACHMENT LIMITATION ===
  The primary attachment is the chat screenshot (bf89f363..., 1.3MB). Four supporting images were sent in the same message — two supplier spec sheets and two Chinese e-commerce listing screenshots. Because the reporting tool accepts one attachment per submission, the chat screenshot carrying the actual ask is attached here; the four spec images remain on the autopilot host at /tmp/discord_attachments/ (77d86d4b..., 4f152de2..., 388b2405..., 29d45327...) if a combined evidence pack is wanted later. OCR confidence on those four was 47-65%, so nothing in this entry rests on their finer print beyond the QL-1585 / 5g / 34*34*4mm / PC mould facts, which were read consistently across English and chi_sim passes.
  
  === OPEN THREAD ===
  Awaiting Kirsten's answer on whether the 5g PC mould exists in her space. If she does not have it, the QL-1585 listing is a concrete fallback to price. Either way, the Chinese-market order hypothesis needs the six heavy-metal results before it can be quoted as a real order rather than a possibility.
  
  PR FIELD NOTE: operational/procurement follow-up, no code change, so no PR of its own. The two PR URLs cited carry the PDF/markdown artefact work from this same thread and are included only because the reporting tool requires a pull URL and rejects non-pull links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 16.67
- Attached Filename: kirsten_5gram_chocolate_mould_chinese_market_2026-11-20.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/kirsten_5gram_chocolate_mould_chinese_market_2026-11-20.pdf
--------
